method.change: Only the explicitly named component changes; all plant weights and other components remain fixed.
method.bootstrap: 200 paired circular 14-day blocks, seed 4173, identical case-count draws across models and slices. Every sampled case retains its outputs. Slice masks are fixed before scores are compared. Percentile intervals condition on selected predictions and do not correct repeated development selection; endpoints are approximate.
method.slice_bootstrap: Existing WeightedAUC computes exact masked pooled AUC using the original whole-case repetition counts. Invalid single-class draws, if any, are counted explicitly and excluded only for that slice interval. Positive-draw fraction is not a p-value or a future-improvement probability.
method.slice_metrics: Within-slice AUC and incident pair error rate use existing PairDiagnostics. The incident rate includes cross-generator pairs with either endpoint in a slice; overlapping slice incidences must not be summed. Slice bootstrap intervals concern within-slice AUC only.
method.transition_masks: Transitions come from the common truth with radii 2 and 6 hours. Masks are diagnostics, never model inputs or selection rules.
method.interpretation: Both years are reused development data. Frozen and native 2022 are deployment scenarios on the same labels, not independent replications. Jan7+ excludes six starts overlapping 2021 selection horizons.

component_diversity_diagnostics.method: Cached old/new LightGBM compared with the unchanged remainder of the current ensemble, normalized by 1 minus the fixed plant LightGBM coefficient. Residuals are probability minus truth. Smaller probability MAD or larger residual correlation indicates more similar predictions/errors; this is descriptive and does not identify a causal mechanism for pooled ranking changes. No weights, thresholds or variants are selected.
